claim_variants: The fetched BODC series surface exposes JR15001 navigation coordinate parameters suitable for a coordinate-bearing track reconstruction.
The fetched JR53 cruise surface links the cruise to EM120 multibeam and TOPAS acquisition, retaining JR53 as a parallel native-track branch.
CTBTO workshop material reports that H10S calibration response changes appeared after electronic noise began in one hydrophone channel, with cross-talk to the other two channels.
CTBTO calibration material links the onset of electronic noise in one H10S hydrophone channel to changes in calibration response and cross-talk into the other two channels.

CTBT IMS hydrophone stations receive laboratory end-to-end calibration before deployment, and deployed underwater electronics can be checked with known calibration waveforms injected into the digitizer path.
EarthScope returned direct FDSN channel metadata for IM.H10N1 in this run.
EarthScope returned direct FDSN channel metadata for IM.H10S2 in this run.
The fetched equatorial-Atlantic hydroacoustic paper contains 250-Hz HA10/corpus acquisition context suitable for the preregistered blind 117–121 Hz corpus gate.
A 2025 JASA Express Letters analysis states that H10S hydrophone S1 data are available until October 2013 and uses only S2/S3 for a homogeneous long-term set.
The 2025 H10 long-term analysis states that continuous H10 data are available from 23 March 2005 onward, with S1 included only until October 2013.
A fetched cruise source links Ascension coverage with EM120 multibeam and TOPAS/sub-bottom acquisition.
MGDS exposes a public equatorial-Atlantic T-phase origin catalog spanning August 2011 to January 2015, located from eight autonomous moored hydrophones plus HA10; the data file is ASCII text.
The MGDS landing-page HTML exposed candidate file/data UID tokens that can be tested against its download service.
MGDS documents a FileServer route that returns file data UIDs for direct download and supports geographic/time filters plus full_info, summary and geometry outputs.
The NOAA-hosted 2022 paper reports a final equatorial-Atlantic T-phase catalog of 6,843 events from hydrophones deployed between 2011 and 2015.
BAS/PDC record GB/NERC/BAS/PDC/01236 is the canonical Ascension Island bathymetric compilation and states an approximately 50 m grid derived from multibeam swath data.
H10N1 is inside the published PDC/01236 bounding box.
H10S2 is outside the published PDC/01236 bounding box.
The public PDC/01236 product is distributed in NetCDF and Arc/Info/ArcView ASCII forms and is covered by the UK Open Government Licence.
The PDC/01236 lineage names four RRS James Clark Ross source cruises: JR53-AMT11, JR287, JR15001 and JR16-NG.
The compilation was produced with MB-System 5.5.2336/mbgrid using a Gaussian weighted mean, with source cleaning performed using mbedit.
